Extract all images from a document into metadata

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Gallery</title></head><body><img src=\"https://example.com/photo1.jpg\" alt=\"Photo 1\"><img src=\"https://example.com/photo2.png\" alt=\"Photo 2\"><img src=\"/local/image.webp\" alt=\"Local image\"></body></html>", options)
    println(result.content)
    println(result.metadata.images)
}
```
